title: Friends don't let friends use NSE or KGE for hydrologic model accuracy evaluation
notes: Argues RMSE/MAE superior to NSE/KGE; NSE/KGE values vary due to flow characteristics not model accuracy; recommends error-only metrics

title: Comment on Williams (2025): Friends don't let friends use NSE or KGE
notes: Agrees NSE/KGE overused uncritically; disagrees with abandoning skill scores; no operational joint rule proposed

title: Introducing the Model Fidelity Metric (MFM) for robust and diagnostic land surface model evaluation
notes: Measures accuracy + variability + distribution similarity; targets NSE/KGE failures; synthetic case studies; large-sample validation; HESS not EMS

title: Standard assessments of climate forecast skill can be misleading
notes: Shows model skill rankings change between hindcast/forecast assessment; El Niño-Southern Oscillation; criteria choice drives reversal; Nature Comms not EMS

title: Rolling-Origin Validation Reverses Model Rankings in Multi-Step PM10 Forecasting
notes: Rolling-origin protocol changes model rankings vs. static split; PM10 daily 2017-2024 Spain; skill horizon profile; arXiv preprint not yet in EMS

title: GCMeval — An interactive tool for evaluation and selection of climate model ensembles
notes: Multi-criteria GCM selection via weighted skill scores (bias/RMSE/correlation per variable/region/season); climate model evaluation not time series forecast fidelity
